# 24PA (24私助) — AI Personal Assistant for Feishu / Lark
**English** | 中文 | npm | Releases
**From “remind me” to “prepare my week” — turn conversations into organized, reviewable action witho
ut giving up control.**
`@benz-ai-x/dsh-24pa` is a self-hosted AI personal-assistant plugin for dsh. Local DSH sessions and
a Feishu bot coordinate seven business workers in one owner-bound workspace; the desktop workspace a
dds sixteen capability cards for agent skills, scheduled tasks, calendars, todos, structured memory,
handwriting review, and delivery evidence.
*English desktop interface with sample data.*
`0.2.2-rc.1.8` fixes complete numbered plan confirmations, accurate notification previews for paused
plans, and recovery of manually closed or multiple WeChat inputs (#279). The original plan identity
, on/off choice, voice, and delivery channel remain intact; closed inputs are not revived. Previous
query validation and scoped Host tool permission fixes remain included. Owner QR binding, private te
xt requests, and common plan management are included. Scheduled WeChat notifications are deferred. S
ee the WeChat setup guide. Owner QR binding, the help reply, and a read-only todo query result have
been confirmed in WeChat; real numbered continuation and plan confirmation remain pending in #279. P
rotocol and isolated test evidence is recorded in PR #282.
This fix requires dsh `0.2.2-rc.1` and its native tool execution guard. Older hosts must use their m
atching plugin version in the table below.
## Why 24PA?
- **More than a chatbot.** Move from a request to a work item, a Skill run, a platform object, and a

traceable result — with schedules and follow-through built in.
- **Keep the tools you already use.*
* Work with original Feishu calendars, todos, documents, and notifications, plus WeCom calendars, to

dos, and one-way notifications — without forcing another source of truth.
- **Automation you can act
ually govern.** Inspect Skill packages and versions, preview permissions, separate execution from de

livery, and keep human approval distinct from action authorization.
- **A personal-assistant surface
that can grow.** Cards organize focused capabilities on one shared workspace and runtime, so new sc
enarios can be added without creating another disconnected bot.
## Card-based assistant architecture
The bundle combines one assistant preset with a host plugin. Conversational coordination and the des
ktop card surface share the same owner identity, role boundaries, Skill and schedule runtime, work r
ecords, storage, and delivery evidence.
**Cards are the product's extension unit.** A new personal-assistant scenario can add a focused card
while reusing the same workspace, permissions, plans, run history, and operational foundation. The
sixteen solid cards below are implemented today; the dashed card is an extension direction, not a cl
aim that this release already exposes a third-party card SDK.
## Sixteen implemented cards
Every card below is part of the current product. Ordinary browsing is read-only and does not silentl
y start a model, create a platform object, or run a task.
### Work & plans — 5 cards
| Card | What it helps you do | Included capabilities |
| **Skill management** | Turn reusable know-how into controlled assistant capabilities. | Create/imp
ort Markdown or ZIP; edit and copy; complete package tree and read-only file preview; immutable vers

ions; linked plans; test, run, disable, roll back, delete, and download. |
| **Scheduled tasks** | P
ut one-off and recurring work on a persistent timeline. | Blank, preset, or copied plans; Skill para
meters, fixed time zone, approved targets and delivery; occurrence preview; enable, pause, resume, r

un now, delete, restore, and history. |
[该节后续省略]
### Knowledge & materials — 2 cards
| Card | What it helps you do | Included capabilities |
[该节后续省略]
### Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (the default SQLite ledger uses built-in `node:sqlite`).
- dsh `0

.2.2-rc.1` for the current release line.
- No Feishu credentials are needed for the initial demo. Po
stgreSQL is optional.
## Architecture and safeguards
- **One preset, role-specific permissions.** Local sessions can use the standard coding toolset; Fei
shu entry sessions and business workers receive business-only allowlists. Managed Skill runs use the

ir saved package and permission snapshots.
- **Local-first ledger.** SQLite is the zero-service defa
ult at `data/pa24.db` in the workspace; explicitly configured PostgreSQL is also supported. Durable

inbox/outbox records preserve origin and delivery targets.
- **No blind replay of external writes.**
An unknown platform result is reconciled against the original object before any retry. A successful

action is not repeated merely to repair a local record or delivery.
- **Secrets stay out of prompts
and backups.** Use server environment values or the write-only workspace secret store (`.24pa/secre
ts.json`, mode `0600`); environment values take precedence. `AGENTS.md` stores rules and non-secret

configuration.
- **Review is not execution.** Approving a handwriting version does not execute its c
andidate actions. Notes, documents, minutes, web content, and subagent replies are material, not aut

horization.
- **Calendar-native clock reminders.** Feishu or WeCom owns the native alert; the ledger
keeps backup and reconciliation records. Actual device delivery still depends on the platform and v
erified account configuration.
Read the package reference for configuration fields, storage ownership, failure recovery, permission
details, and the source map.
